note: checkpoint lamps (v2). position / forward / up: booth frame (Checkpoint prefab: x toward the road, y toward the back, z up, m); *Unity: (-x, z, -y) in the prefab. intensityURP at 100 %. group power = only with the booth's power (the battery in the cabinet, both clamps on, the switch at BATTERIE): the fluorescent batten (flickers a few seconds as it strikes; lens M_Kpp_Lamp_Fluor, glow Glow_Fluor with it) and the bulkhead over the door (Glow_Bulk_Door shown, Lens_Bulk_Door -> M_Kpp_Lamp_Bulk). With the power the kit instances light too: the monitors' screens (M_Kit_Screen_On), the lamps (M_Kit_Lamp_*), the door lock's lamp, the cabinet's lamp; the barrier's beacon (Kit_Beacon: its own light, snow_kit_lights.json) turns while the boom moves. Point lights: the IES files describe the shape.
